mapper.sql: id, order_no, channel, trade_no, amount, status, notify_payload, paid_time, created_date, updated_date
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO payment_record (order_no, channel, trade_no, amount, status, created_date, updated_date) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{channel}, #{tradeNo}, #{amount}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_record SET status = 'PAID', trade_no = #{tradeNo}, notify_payload = #{notifyPayload}, paid_time = COALESCE(paid_time, #{paidTime}), updated_date = NOW() WHERE channel = #{channel} AND order_no = #{orderNo} AND status <> 'PAID'
UPDATE payment_record SET status = 'CLOSED', updated_date = NOW() WHERE channel = #{channel} AND order_no = #{orderNo} AND status <> 'PAID'
